name: UNITE cross-validation, cancers with ichorCNA tumour fraction 0 to 0.03 vs healthy (Wang et al. 2026)
description: Tumour-fraction-stratified cross-validation of fragmentomic feature sets and an ichorCNA tumour-fraction classifier.

attributes.protocol: Restrict cancer samples to those with ichorCNA tumour fraction 0 to 0.03 (healthy controls unchanged), train each model in nested cross-validation (5 outer folds, 10 repeats, StratifiedGroupKFold so no patient is in both training and test folds) and summarise each metric over the 50 outer test folds.
attributes.version: Wang et al. 2026 Data file S2 sheets STATS_xgb_x1-x6 and STATS_lr; Methods P47, P49
limitations: Cross-validation within one pooled set of public and new data; not the held-out or unseen test sets.
Tumour fraction strata are defined by ichorCNA, which is also the input of the ichorCNA-TF comparator.
Author-reported by the UNITE developers; the DELFI-XGB comparator is reported only in text and figures.
All strata share the same healthy controls (325 in the cross-validation set); only the cancers change.

The cross-validation set draws 352 samples from the Cristiano et al. 2019 (DELFI) FinaleDB data and 86 from the Jiang et al. FinaleDB liver data, the cohorts of the Hou et al. evaluations and the DELFI judgement.

attributes.endpoint: Cross-validated ROC-AUC, AUPRC and default-threshold metrics of five fragmentomic feature sets and their combination (UNITE-XGB), and of an ichorCNA tumour-fraction classifier, for cancers with ichorCNA tumour fraction above 0.1 vs healthy; the comparator's fixed-specificity values are not shown
attributes.rationale: Same comparison in a higher or unstratified tumour-fraction stratum; it shows how feature rankings change with tumour fraction rather than performance at realistic low fractions.
constraints: Inspect every linked evaluation's source locator and preserved conflicts before citing a result.
Do not combine this mapping's evaluations with any other protocol's results; cohorts, features, classifiers and validation designs differ between sources.
limitations: Cross-validation within the 70% training split (1,237 samples); not the held-out or unseen test sets.
Fixed-specificity sensitivity is printed only for the ichorCNA-TF comparator; the fragmentomic models have AUC, AUPRC and default-threshold metrics only.
Strata are defined by ichorCNA estimates, which are unreliable below about 3%; the strata are not measured tumour fractions.
Author-reported by the UNITE developers; three authors are named inventors on pending patent applications for the methods.

The cross-validation set draws 352 samples from the Cristiano et al. 2019 (DELFI) FinaleDB data and 86 from the Jiang et al. FinaleDB liver data, the cohorts of the Hou et al. judgements and the DELFI judgement.

The ichorCNA-TF comparator's fixed-specificity values are not shown: it separates every fold perfectly (AUROC, sensitivity and specificity 1), yet the sheet prints sensitivity 0 at 95%, 98% and 99% specificity.
